policy: Every 3D asset must be declared here before use. Generated images are original project assets based on user-provided visual direction only; reference images are not copied or stored.

assets.name: Generated Kurukshetra unit reference image set
assets.author: MIRROR project using built-in image generation
assets.modifications: chroma-key background removal, crop, trim, board texture placement, and archived visual reference. Playable units are now procedural Three.js meshes rather than sprite/image-card pieces.

assets.name: Kurukshetra production GLB pack with CharMorph humanoid rigs
assets.source: mixed: CharMorph MB-Lab AGPL3-derived humanoid rigs plus MIRROR procedural Blender animal/vehicle shells
assets.author: MIRROR project; CharMorph/MB-Lab for humanoid base meshes and fitted cloth/hair
assets.license: AGPL-3.0-or-later; humanoid bodies and mounted riders are AGPL3-derived from CharMorph MB-Lab mb_male
assets.modifications: Six standalone humanoid files are generated with Product/scripts/generate-kurukshetra-charmorph-humanoid-glbs.py from CharMorph/MB-Lab mb_male, fitted with CharMorph lower-body cloth/hair meshes, then dressed with MIRROR-authored leather armor, weapons, banners, shields, and faction accents. Horse archer, war elephant, and war chariot files are generated with Product/scripts/generate-kurukshetra-charmorph-mounted-glbs.py: CharMorph/MB-Lab skinned riders/drivers are seated on MIRROR-authored procedural horse, elephant, chariot, tack, wheel, and howdah shells. Future approved replacements must preserve slot filenames and required clip names.
assets.attributionRequirement: Document CharMorph/MB-Lab AGPL3 derivation for all humanoid and mounted-rider GLBs and keep AGPL-compatible source/license notes.
assets.notes: All playable files with a human now include 159-joint skinned CharMorph real-human rigs; mounted files add rider_idle/rider_move/rider_attack/rider_hit overlays. Animal and vehicle shells remain procedural and remain the largest visible realism gap. The runtime plays embedded animation clips plus role-specific combat cues, but this is still not a final PUBG/GTA/Harry-Potter-chess realism pack.
